name: The Nisshin OilliO Group,Ltd.
summary: The Nisshin OilliO Group,Ltd. engages in food and ingredients business in Japan, rest of Asia, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Processed Oils and Fat Business; Oils, Fats, and Processed Foods/Materials Business; and Fine Chemicals Business. The company offers edible oil for use in household, commercial, and food processing applications; and food for the elderly and nursing care patients. It also provides processed palm oil products, confectionery fats, margarines, shortenings; and chocolate-related products, household-use salad dressing, wellness food, MCT, lecithin, tocopherol, edible soybeans, and soy protein.
